arxiv.title: Persona Perspectives: Adopting Viewpoints Reorganizes Representations in LLMs
arxiv.abstract: Common methods for monitoring features in large language models (LLMs) such as linear probes and sparse autoencoders (SAEs) assume that features maintain a consistent representation across contexts. LLMs, however, can flexibly adopt different perspectives or "personas" that suggest different underlying systems of conceptual relations. In this paper, we examine whether prompting an LLM to adopt a persona alters the representational geometry of the model's latent space. We extract representations of over 9,000 common words and 33 semantic axes from models adopting liberal and conservative political personas and compare these against two neutral baselines. We find that persona conditioning systematically alters both the projections of words onto semantic axes and the alignments among the axes themselves in directions consistent with the specified ideology. We then test the implications of this reorganization for two safety-relevant features: truthfulness and morality. Linear probes, SAE-based classifiers, and classifiers built from manually selected word representations, all trained without a persona, produce divergent results when applied to models conditioned on political personas, producing politically slanted ratings of truth and morality on controversial statements. These findings suggest that internal representations, as they are conventionally extracted, can exhibit different geometric relations when the model adopts personas, potentially undermining monitoring efforts.
arxiv.titleZh: 人格视角：采纳不同 viewpoint 会重组 LLM 的内部表征
arxiv.summaryZh: 线性探针与稀疏自编码器（SAE）等特征监控手段默认特征在不同语境下表征一致，而 LLM 可以灵活切换不同「人格」，从而隐含不同的概念关系体系。研究让模型分别采纳自由派与保守派政治人格，抽取 9000 余个常用词与 33 条语义轴的表示，与两个中性基线对比，发现人格条件会系统性地改变词在语义轴上的投影以及语义轴之间的对齐方向，且变化方向与指定意识形态一致。进一步在真实性、道德性两项安全相关特征上测试：未加人格条件训练的线性探针、SAE 分类器与人工选词分类器，在人格化模型上给出分歧且带政治倾向的评分。这说明常规方式抽取的内部表示会随人格而改变几何关系，可能削弱监控与安全评估的可靠性。
arxiv.reason: 探针与SAE表征监控在人格条件下的失效，属可解释性与对齐评估的扎实工作

arxiv.title: Navigating Disagreement Among Criteria for Evaluating Explanation Faithfulness
arxiv.abstract: Faithfulness requires that algorithmic explanations accurately reflect the model's behavior. Yet existing operationalizations of faithfulness can disagree about whether the same explanation is faithful, leaving developers and auditors to choose among conflicting evaluations. In this paper, we investigate disagreement among evaluation criteria and offer a practical path forward for evaluating explanation faithfulness. We first identify how operationalizations of faithfulness differ. We introduce a faithfulness functional that locates their disagreements in what an explanation claims about the model, which comparisons bear on that claim, and how agreement across those comparisons should be aggregated, and we reconstruct existing evaluation criteria within it. We argue these reconstructions support understanding faithfulness as a common though incompletely specified relation between the model and explanation, so the differences reflect choices left open by the general requirement. Justifying an operationalization then comes down to justifying these choices, which, on our view, draws on explanatory, institutional, and normative considerations. We support this argument with a case study of adverse action notices, reconstructing the evaluation implicit in an industry-proposed procedure and identifying which of its choices the setting justifies and which remain open. Our work gives auditors and practitioners a way to navigate disagreeing evaluations of faithfulness. It also explains why the literature should expect multiple operationalizations, while showing how concrete settings can narrow the choice among them. More broadly, our analysis shows how a shared requirement of faithfulness can support contextually justified evaluations despite disagreement among existing metrics.
arxiv.titleZh: 在解释忠实性的评估标准之间导航分歧
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对同一解释在不同忠实性操作化定义下可能被判定为忠实或不忠实、开发者与审计者只能面对冲突结论的问题，提出一个「忠实性泛函」，把各类准则的差异定位到三个环节：解释对模型作出了什么断言、哪些比较与该断言相关、以及如何聚合这些比较上的一致程度，并在该框架内重构既有评估准则。作者据此论证忠实性是模型与解释之间共有但未被完全指定的关系，操作化的正当性取决于解释性、制度与规范性层面的选择；并以「不利行动通知」为案例，重建某行业提议流程中隐含的评估，指出哪些选择由场景支撑、哪些仍待定。工作为审计者与从业者在相互冲突的忠实性评估之间取舍提供了可操作的路径，也解释了文献中为何应预期多种操作化并存。

arxiv.title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. Our analysis identifies three findings: high-value designs coordinate capacity improvements with load selection; agents interpret performance feedback through workload-relevant experiments; and reliable delivery requires verification of the execution paths introduced by optimization. Overall, ServerBench supports systematic study of how agents translate service objectives and feedback into effective, verified serving systems for given task specifications.
arxiv.titleZh: ServerBench：你的编码智能体能否设计专用的 LLM 服务系统？
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM 编码智能体能否自主构建支撑自身运行的服务系统这一缺少评测的问题，ServerBench 要求智能体在会话依赖、延迟约束与正确性要求下设计完整的 LLM 服务系统。基准用状态化回放保留会话依赖，用独立验证检查提交的系统，并以「每美元 GPU 成本下延迟合格的 token 价值」作为统一目标。在 11 个编码智能体模型与三种部署设置下，Claude Sonnet 5.5 在 Gemma E4B 上达到 2.97 美元/美元，为 vLLM 参考实现的 4.87 倍；33 次运行中 22 次产出经通过验证的系统，13 次超过最强基线。该基准可用于系统研究智能体如何将服务目标与性能反馈转化为有效且经通过验证的服务系统。
arxiv.reason: 编码智能体自主设计 LLM 服务系统，命中 Agent 与系统效率方向

arxiv.title: Before You Continue: Evaluating Time-Sensitive Safety Awareness in Conversational Assistants
arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM) assistants increasingly help users with everyday activities that involve time-dependent constraints. However, users may not mention these constraints in later requests, requiring assistants to recognize and adjust their advice accordingly. To evaluate such capability, we introduce TASC (Temporal Action Safety in Conversation), a benchmark that evaluates whether LLMs apply time-dependent constraints when responding to conversational requests. TASC consists of 3,418 inputs derived from 128 templates, along with a separate set of 33 scenarios designed to compare models' ability to calculate elapsed time with their ability to apply that information. Across 13 models, assistants account for time-dependent constraints in only 30.5% of cases where the proposed action violates a rule, while rarely warning users unnecessarily. More importantly, models fail to apply these constraints in 62.1% of cases despite correctly calculating the elapsed time. Explicitly providing the timing resolves only about half of these failures, revealing a gap between temporal reasoning and its application in conversational advice.
arxiv.titleZh: 在下结论之前：评估对话助手对时间敏感的安全意识
arxiv.summaryZh: 评估LLM助手在对话中是否会把时间相关约束纳入建议：构建TASC基准，3,418条输入来自128个模板，另有33个场景对比模型计算已过时间与应用该信息的能力。13个模型在建议动作违反规则时仅30.5%考虑了时间约束，且很少多余警告；62.1%的失败案例中模型正确算出已过时间却未应用，显式给出时间也只能解决约一半。揭示了时间推理与对话建议应用之间的鸿沟。
arxiv.reason: 对话助手时间约束安全基准，属评测与方法学方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Context--Answer Metamodels: Forecasting LLM Activations Before the First Answer Token
arxiv.abstract: Under stochastic decoding, a single context can elicit many different answers from a language model. Characterizing this variation typically requires many expensive autoregressive rollouts, each revealing only one realization. We ask whether the activations produced while reading the context can directly forecast the model's rollout activations. We train context--answer metamodels that map a context activation sequence to point or distribution forecasts of mean-pooled answer activations. We find that (i) the four metamodel families we study forecast mean-pooled answer activations with high fidelity, and the distribution metamodels also capture rollout variability; (ii) performance improves as the training set grows to 500,000 prompts, and the metamodels generalize zero-shot to out-of-domain datasets; (iii) their forecasts retain behavior-predictive signal; and (iv) context activations from Qwen2.5 predict mean-pooled answer activations from Qwen3.5 and Gemma 4, suggesting that activation forecasts can transfer across models. Together, these results suggest that context activation traces can support scalable forecasts of behaviors in LLM answers before the first answer token is generated.
arxiv.titleZh: 上下文—答案元模型：在首个答案 token 之前预测 LLM 激活
arxiv.summaryZh: 随机解码下同一上下文可产生多种答案，完整刻画这一分布需大量昂贵的自回归 rollout。该工作训练上下文—答案元模型（context–answer metamodel），把上下文激活序列映射为答案平均池化激活的点预测或分布预测：四类元模型均能高保真预测，分布模型还能刻画 rollout 波动；训练集扩到 500,000 条 prompt 时性能持续提升，并可零样本泛化到域外数据集，预测仍保留行为判别信号。用 Qwen2.5 的上下文激活可预测 Qwen3.5 与 Gemma 4 的答案激活，说明激活预测可跨模型迁移，为在生成首个答案 token 前低成本预判 LLM 行为提供路径。
arxiv.reason: 激活层面预判 LLM 行为以替代 rollout，机制分析类工作，方向有趣但偏增量

arxiv.title: LooM: Loop-Invariant Memory for Causal Encoder-Decoder Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by re-executing shared layers, but three limitations hinder their adoption: memory grows with the loop count, compute can only be adjusted in whole-block steps, and the loop count is hard to change after training. We propose LooM (Loop-invariant Memory), which addresses each in turn. In a causal encoder-decoder (CED), LooM loops only the decoder layers after the first, which read a global memory written once per token, and each of them publishes the key-value (KV) entry for a token only on its first visit, so the cache does not grow with the loop count. These layers loop independently, providing every budget from 3 to 21 layer executions per token, and one model trained on randomly sampled budgets covers all of them without a router. With enough loops, LooM outperforms a single-pass baseline trained on the same data on language modeling, zero-shot accuracy and long-context perplexity, while using the same cache size. Our analysis further shows that the training budget distribution decides what extra depth buys. These results suggest that a CED is a natural place to loop: memory is written once, and depth becomes a budget chosen at deployment.
arxiv.titleZh: LooM:面向因果编码器-解码器语言模型的循环不变内存
arxiv.summaryZh: 循环 Transformer 靠重复执行共享层提升有效深度，却受限于显存随循环数增长、算力只能按整块调整、训练后循环数难以更改。LooM 在因果编码器-解码器中只循环首层之后的解码器层，这些层读取每个 token 仅写一次的全局内存，且只在首次访问时发布该 token 的 KV 条目，缓存因而不随循环数增长;各层独立循环，单个 token 可获得 3 到 21 次层执行预算，一个在随机采样预算上训练的模型即可覆盖全部预算，无需路由器。在相同缓存大小下，循环足够多时其语言建模、零样本准确率与长上下文困惑度均优于同数据训练的单次前向基线，并进一步表明训练预算分布决定额外深度买到什么。
arxiv.reason: 循环 Transformer 架构与 KV cache 改进，直接命中 LLM 架构方向

arxiv.title: Systolic Linear Attention: Co-Designing Tile-Grouped Gated Delta Attention for TPUs
arxiv.abstract: Gated-delta linear attention layers such as Gated DeltaNet (GDN), Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), and GDN-2 are tuned for GPUs, where small tensor-core tiles and fast vector registers make per-channel decay rescaling and sequential in-block solves cheap. On Google TPUs, which concentrate compute in wide $256 \times 256$ systolic matrix units backed by a slower vector unit, porting these layers directly leaves half of each matrix tile empty and bottlenecks on vector operations. We present \textbf{Systolic Linear Attention (SLA)}, which reshapes gated delta attention around the matrix unit by widening keys to $256$ with grouped value heads, grouping decay gates into four $64$-channel tiles, and computing the chunk solve entirely with block matrix products in a single fused kernel. On TPU v7x, a full \texttt{SLA-R4} layer runs $1.6\times$--$2.5\times$ faster than the open-source Tokamax KDA kernel ($1.4\times$--$2.4\times$ with exact chunk inversion), driven primarily by head sharing and kernel fusion. Across a $2{,}048$-chip TPU v7x pre-training study of sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models from $6.5\text{B}$ to $63.1\text{B}$ parameters, SLA trains $11\%$--$24\%$ faster than KDA at similar perplexity, and reaches slightly lower perplexity than KDA in smaller matched-seed runs.
arxiv.titleZh: Systolic Linear Attention：为 TPU 协同设计分块分组门控 Delta 注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 门控 delta 线性注意力（GDN、KDA、GDN-2）原本针对 GPU 的小张量核 tile 与快速向量寄存器设计，迁移到以 256×256 脉动矩阵单元为核心、向量单元较慢的 TPU 上时，矩阵 tile 有一半空置，并且受向量运算瓶颈限制。SLA 通过分组 value head 把 key 拓宽到 256、将 decay gate 归并为四个 64 通道 tile，并用纯块矩阵乘在单个融合 kernel 内完成 chunk solve。在 TPU v7x 上，完整 SLA-R4 层比开源 Tokamax KDA kernel 快 1.6–2.5 倍（精确 chunk 求逆下为 1.4–2.4 倍）；在 2,048 芯片、6.5B–63.1B 参数的稀疏 MoE 预训练中，同困惑度下训练快 11%–24%，较小规模同种子实验的困惑度还略低。该工作为线性注意力在 TPU 上的软硬件协同设计提供了可复用范式。
arxiv.reason: 线性注意力架构与 TPU kernel 协同设计，含 63B MoE 预训练验证

arxiv.title: Rules, Traces and Routing Statistics: Training and Calibration Data for Open Models on ARC-AGI-2
arxiv.abstract: We study which training and calibration data help three open models solve ARC-AGI-2 tasks when the solver runs offline on four L4 GPUs for at most 12 hours. We compare data offline on public tasks and report 189 runs on the 120 hidden semi-private tasks. For the NVARC Qwen3-4B grid model, we built a corpus of 12,000 executable rules in a typed language and 95,993 tasks; a rule is admitted only if its behaviour on a fixed probe set differs from that of every admitted rule, and a task only if its pairs refute a shortlist of nearest competing rules and defeat 12 shortcut solvers. Continued fine-tuning on 1,920 real task records with revised four-GPU scheduling raised the semi-private score from 28.96 (mean of the released model) to 33.06 (mean of five runs, best 34.86); no checkpoint trained with synthetic tasks, even all 95,993 of them, improved on the real-task model. For the Qwen3.8-27B reasoning model, we fine-tuned on 1,036 of its own reasoning traces with correct final answers and compared sets that add traces of other models and synthetic tasks. With an inference procedure built around the model (a thinking cap enforced in the serving engine, a Python program checked on the demonstrations after each answer, a long first attempt per input), the score rose from 26.81 to 44.03, the level the ARC Prize Foundation measured for the base model without a time limit (42.36); most of the gain came from the inference procedure. For the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model (125B parameters, 6B active), GPU memory limited concurrency. Pruning from 512 to 384 experts per layer by router-weighted activation saliency grew the key-value cache from 0.55M to 1.39M tokens; a 296-expert list adapted with ARC routing statistics, keeping experts for program tokens, plus an FP8 indexer cache, reached 1.96M. With a tool that checks programs, the model scored 56.67, our best result.
arxiv.titleZh: 规则、轨迹与路由统计:面向 ARC-AGI-2 开放模型的训练与校准数据
arxiv.summaryZh: 在四张 L4 GPU、12 小时离线的约束下，比较训练与校准数据对三个开放模型解 ARC-AGI-2 的作用，共在 120 道半私有题上运行 189 次。为 Qwen3-4B 构建 12,000 条类型化可执行规则与 95,993 个任务，但只有用 1,920 条真实任务记录继续微调才把分数从 28.96 提到 33.06(五次最佳 34.86)，合成任务全无增益。27B 推理模型靠 serving 端 thinking cap、Python 校验与长首答的推理流程从 26.81 升至 44.03;125B MoE 按路由器加权激活显著性裁剪专家，使 KV cache 从 0.55M 扩到 1.96M token，配合程序检查工具取得 56.67。
arxiv.reason: 后训练数据与 MoE 路由裁剪兼具，但偏 ARC 专项

arxiv.title: SAUCE: Summary Analysis Using Conversation Entailment
arxiv.abstract: With the growing need for evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs) and their applications to speech, challenges persist in summarizing and evaluating conversations that lack a clear end goal. We introduce SAUCE -- a reference-free, fact-based evaluation pipeline for cross-lingual conversational speech summarization. It measures the accuracy and the fact coverage of a summary through the entailment between conversation and text. We compare SAUCE against several popular summarization metrics and demonstrate the effectiveness of capturing information loss due to transcription and translation error and identifying broken summaries. Crucially, unlike black-box LLM evaluators or dense embedding metrics, SAUCE is inherently explainable: it maps summary scores to discrete, verifiable facts, allowing users to pinpoint exact hallucinations or omissions. We illustrate how this interpretability helps developers systematically profile LLM behaviors and gives end-users an actionable tool to verify summary accuracy in noisy, real-world conditions. Preliminary investigations show SAUCE strongly align with human judgment.
arxiv.comment: Accepted and published to the ACL GEM workshop. Proceedings of the Fifth Workshop on Generation, Evaluation and Metrics (GEM), pages 364-377, San Diego, California, USA. Association for Computational Linguistics
arxiv.titleZh: SAUCE：基于对话蕴含的摘要分析
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对缺乏明确终点的多语种对话语音摘要，构建无参考、基于事实的评估流程 SAUCE:通过对话与摘要文本之间的蕴含关系，同时衡量摘要的准确性与事实覆盖度。该方法能捕捉转写与翻译错误造成的信息损失，并识别结构破碎的摘要。与黑盒 LLM 评判器和稠密嵌入指标不同，SAUCE 将摘要得分映射到离散、可验证的事实，使幻觉与遗漏可被精确定位。初步实验显示其与人工判断高度一致。
arxiv.reason: 语音对话摘要的蕴含式评估，偏语音应用，仅评估方法学擦边

arxiv.title: LLMs Don't Know What They Know: Benchmarking Temporal Self-Knowledge for Financial Backtesting
arxiv.abstract: Financial backtests of large language models (LLMs) are meaningful only if the model did not already know the outcomes it is asked to predict. Practitioners guard against this by trusting a vendor's stated knowledge cutoff, by asking the model what it knows, or by instructing it to answer as of a past date. To verify whether any of these safeguards can be trusted, we introduce FinDendro, a benchmark of 2,226 dated U.S. facts from 1999 to 2026, covering monthly macroeconomic series, month-end stock prices and Federal Reserve decisions. Each fact yields four prompts: a value question, Recall and Predict questions that pair each candidate value with a claim of knowing or guessing without a declared date, and a Predict question with a historical declared date. Controls for persistence and dominant outcomes keep chance accuracy near 0.27. Results show that for most frontier models, self-reports understate knowledge. GPT-5 answers 76% of controlled facts correctly but claims to know 38%, and answers 61% of the facts it says it does not know. Knowledge claims can persist beyond the measured knowledge boundary, by up to seven quarters, and a declared date removes most of the claims of prior knowledge while leaving accuracy unchanged. Backtests inside a model's training window therefore cannot be certified leak-free by self-report, instruction or stated cutoff. These findings motivate behavioral measurement of temporal knowledge boundaries, and FinDendro provides a benchmark and procedure for selecting backtest periods based on demonstrated factual knowledge.
arxiv.titleZh: LLM 不知道自己知道什么:面向金融回测的时间自我知识基准测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 金融回测只有在模型事先不知道待预测结果时才有意义，而业界通常靠厂商声明知识截止日期、直接询问模型或指令其按过去某日期作答来防泄漏。为此构建 FinDendro:2,226 条 1999—2026 年美国带日期事实，覆盖月度宏观序列、月末股价与美联储决议，每条事实配四类提示(取值、无日期的 Recall/Predict 知识自述、带历史日期的 Predict)，并以持续性与主导结果做控制，使随机准确率约为 0.27。结果显示前沿模型的自述普遍低估自身知识:GPT-5 在受控事实上答对 76%，却只声称知道 38%，并且在自称不知道的事实中仍答对 61%;知识声称最多可超出实测知识边界七个季度，而声明日期虽能消除大部分先前知识声称，准确率却不变。结论是训练窗口内的回测无法通过自述、指令或厂商截止日期证明无泄漏，需以行为化测量确定知识边界并据此选择回测区间。
arxiv.reason: LLM 时间自我知识与评测可靠性基准，方法扎实但偏垂直应用

arxiv.title: Measuring Risk, Not Harm: Detecting Psychological Harm Risk Factors in LLM Conversations
arxiv.abstract: Psychological harms from interactions with large language models cannot be monitored directly because they may emerge over repeated interactions and depend strongly on subjective individual user context. We propose measuring risk, not harm: detecting observable AI behaviors that constitute risk factors for psychological harm at the AI response level and aggregating these signals to support longitudinal monitoring. We operationalize eight such behaviors and construct a synthetic multi-label corpus of 47,062 AI responses and 373,873 response-factor labels, with targeted human annotations for validation and evaluation. We then compare trained embedding-based classifiers, direct LLM judging, and a classifier--judge cascade. All detectors are model-agnostic and operate only on LLM outputs, requiring no access to internal model states. We apply these detectors to several out-of-distribution human-AI conversation data sets from prior research. On held-out human-labeled data, the best cascade achieves macro precision of 0.86, recall of 0.76, and F1 of 0.79. On WildChat, it reduces LLM-judge calls by 97.1\% relative to direct judging. On DelusionEval, risk-factor detections cluster within conversations. Together, our results show that response-level behavioral risk-factor detection can provide a scalable measurement layer for longitudinal psychological-safety monitoring without conflating observable AI behavior with latent user harm.
arxiv.titleZh: 衡量风险，而非伤害：检测LLM对话中的心理伤害风险因素
arxiv.summaryZh: LLM交互带来的心理伤害难以直接监测，因为它可能在反复对话中累积，并高度依赖用户个体语境；因此改为在单条AI回复层面检测可观测的风险行为，再聚合信号做纵向跟踪。工作定义了八类风险行为，构建了含47,062条AI回复、373,873个标签的多标签合成语料，并辅以人工标注验证；比较嵌入分类器、LLM直接评判与“分类器—评判”级联三种方案，检测器与模型无关且只用输出文本。在留出的人工标注数据上，级联取得宏平均精确率0.86、召回率0.76、F1 0.79，在WildChat上把评判调用减少97.1%，并在DelusionEval上发现风险因素在对话内聚集。该回复级行为检测可作为可扩展的测量层，用于长期心理安全监测，并且不把可观测的AI行为与用户潜在伤害混为一谈。
arxiv.reason: LLM安全测量与judge级联，属评测方法学，与后训练主线略有关联

arxiv.title: Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces
arxiv.abstract: Efficient benchmarking estimates a system's full benchmark performance from a small number of task executions. Standard approaches rely solely on the binary correctness of executions from a collection of already-evaluated reference systems. An agentic system, however, produces a rich trace for each execution that can reveal substantially more about its capabilities. Leveraging this information requires useful trace representations. We propose representing a trace by extracting a structured summary of it with an LLM and embedding the summary with a standard text encoder. These representations preserve correctness- and task-related signal while minimizing the presence of system identity-, model family- and harness-related signals that dominate raw trace embeddings. Given this representation for each task execution from all reference systems, we construct low-dimensional representations of the systems and predict a new system's score from its position among the reference systems. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0, augmenting an item-response model with this geometry-based prediction reduces mean absolute error from 0.13 to 0.08 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-4}$) and from 0.14 to 0.12 (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-3}$), respectively, when provided a single random executed task. Further, given access to the full set of reference systems, our approach dominates baselines for any given number of executed tasks on both benchmarks.
arxiv.titleZh: 基于缓存轨迹的高任务效率 Agent 评测
arxiv.summaryZh: 用少量任务执行估计 Agent 系统在完整 benchmark 上的得分时，现有做法只利用执行结果的二值正确性；而 agentic 系统每次执行产生的完整轨迹含有更多能力信息。方法用 LLM 抽取轨迹的结构化摘要，再用文本编码器嵌入，以此抑制系统身份、模型家族与 harness 等混淆信号，保留正确性与任务相关信号；据此为各参考系统构建低维表示，用新系统在参考系统中的几何位置预测得分，并增强 item-response 模型。在 SWE-bench Verified 上仅执行单个随机任务即把 MAE 从 0.13 降至 0.08（Wilcoxon p<10^{-4}），Terminal-Bench 2.0 上从 0.14 降至 0.12（p<10^{-3}），且任意执行任务数下均优于基线。
arxiv.reason: Agent 评测效率方法，命中 Agent 与评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: Message-passing graph persistence
arxiv.abstract: Message-passing graph neural networks (GNNs) are limited in expressive power by the one-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman test. Persistent homology (PH) provides topological descriptors that can complement GNN representations, but existing approaches typically compute persistence separately from the representation learning process. In this paper, we introduce Message-Passing Graph Persistence (MGP), a family of topological descriptors that incorporates message passing into graph filtrations. At each filtration step, node embeddings are updated using the current subgraph and associated with persistence events. These embeddings also determine the representatives of connected components during persistence computation. We prove that MGP is invariant under graph isomorphism and that it is strictly more expressive than the PH-based descriptors it extends. We evaluate MGP on an expressivity benchmark and on several graph classification and regression datasets. Experiments show that MGP outperforms other PH-based descriptors on most of these datasets.
arxiv.titleZh: 消息传递图持久性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对消息传递GNN受一维WL检验限制、表达力不足，而持久同调(PH)描述子通常与表示学习分离计算的问题，将消息传递嵌入图过滤过程:每个过滤步骤用当前子图更新节点嵌入，并与持久事件关联，该嵌入同时决定持久计算中连通分支的代表元。理论上证明MGP在图同构下不变，且严格强于其所扩展的PH描述子。在表达力基准与多个图分类、回归数据集上，多数任务优于其他PH描述子。为拓扑特征与GNN表示的端到端结合提供了统一框架。
arxiv.reason: GNN与持久同调的交叉理论工作，与LLM各关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Transforming Integer Grids to Spatial Intuition: Perception, Not Planning, Governs ARC-AGI-3
arxiv.abstract: Sample-efficient fluid intelligence requires agents that rapidly form working models of unfamiliar interactive environments. ARC-AGI-3 tests this across uninstructed visual games scored by Relative Human Action Efficiency, which penalizes exploratory waste quadratically. When frontier models read raw integer grids, serialization destroys spatial topology, and they spend hundreds of actions rediscovering basic boundaries and symmetries. We introduce SARBLOH, an open-weight agent built on the premise that spatial perception, not planning capacity, governs interactive reasoning on ARC-AGI-3. A zero-parameter O(HW) perception engine turns each frame, in 35 ms, into an object inventory with bipartite temporal tracking, a geometric briefing that separates proven invariants from affordance hypotheses, and an annotated canvas. Paired with a code-as-action runtime, the agent writes algorithmic hypotheses instead of low-level moves. Across eight presentations, grounded perception raises the rubric score from 3/28 to 25/28 points while cutting token use by 89.4%. On 23 held-out games, geometric invariants generalize with 100% accuracy, while single-frame affordance guesses fall to 6-50%, so active verification probes remain necessary. On the public set, Run A (briefing off) solved 143 of 183 levels in 8.2 hours at 59.4% single-pass efficiency; Run B (briefing on) reached 63.5%. Within the nine-hour budget on one Kaggle RTX PRO 6000 GPU, SARBLOH scored 16.53 on the hidden Kaggle evaluation, 13.7x the first Milestone winner.

arxiv.title: Ranking Agreement Does Not Reveal Paragraph-Edit Agreement in Two Released Paper Acceptance Predictors
arxiv.abstract: A fast acceptance classifier could select revisions for a slower evaluator. We ask whether agreement on existing papers supports that use. We compare a classifier of word and document features with two released text-only acceptance predictors fine-tuned from the same language model with three billion parameters. For 198 papers from the International Conference on Learning Representations, we compare model rankings of the original papers and of paragraph rewrites screened automatically for unchanged facts, claim strength, and attribution. The classifier ranks original papers closely with one predictor and moderately with the other, but shows no detectable agreement with either on which rewrites raise scores. The tests specified in advance used reduced numerical precision. Rounding error dominated the small score responses. We therefore rescored the released weights in full 32-bit precision as a post hoc check; edit agreement remained near zero. At this precision, when each predictor chooses among five rewrites per paper, its average raw score is under two points out of 100 higher than with random choice. The evidence covers presentation rewrites and two open predictors from one family; transfer to costly evaluators remains untested. Revision selectors should therefore be checked against the intended evaluator on the revisions they rank.

arxiv.titleZh: 排序一致性无法揭示两个公开论文录用预测器的段落编辑一致性
arxiv.summaryZh: 用快速录用分类器为更慢的评估器筛选修订稿，前提是对修订的打分也应一致。研究在198篇ICLR论文上比较一个词与文档特征分类器和两个同源30亿参数纯文本录用预测器：在原文排序上，分类器与其中一个高度一致，但在“哪些段落改写会提高分数”上与两者均无可检测的一致性。原检验使用降低的数值精度，舍入误差主导了微小的分差；改用完整32位精度重新打分后，编辑一致性仍接近零，五选一时平均原始分仅比随机选择高不到2分（满分100）。据此，修订筛选器应针对目标评估器、在实际排序的修订上做校验。

arxiv.title: FedFiOT: Fisher-Weighted Optimal Transport for Model Merging in One-Shot and Few-Round Federated Learning
arxiv.abstract: One-shot and few-round federated learning (FL) reduce communication burden by constructing a global model within one or a few communication rounds, but often achieve lower performance than conventional multi-round FL. Without frequent synchronization, client models may drift apart, causing neurons that learn similar features to occupy different positions across clients. At the same time, local data heterogeneity can cause corresponding parameters to differ in their importance to each client's predictions. Together, these challenges cause direct averaging to combine mismatched neurons and assign equal weight to parameters despite differences in their importance. We propose FedFiOT, a Fisher-weighted optimal transport framework for one-shot and few-round FL that leverages Fisher information to quantify parameter importance and guide neuron alignment and model aggregation. FedFiOT jointly optimizes neuron correspondences and global model parameters through alternating minimization of a shared Fisher-weighted objective. Theoretically, we show that FedFiOT's optimization procedure monotonically decreases the layer-wise merging objective and establish a stationarity bound that quantifies the effects of client heterogeneity and nonuniform Fisher weighting.Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over competing baselines in both one-shot and few-round federated learning settings.
arxiv.titleZh: FedFiOT：面向单轮与少轮联邦学习模型合并的 Fisher 加权最优传输
arxiv.summaryZh: 单轮或少轮联邦学习虽然把通信压缩到一到数轮，却因缺少频繁同步而出现客户端神经元错位，加之数据异构导致同一参数对不同客户端的重要性不同，直接平均会把不匹配的神经元混在一起。FedFiOT 用 Fisher 信息量化参数重要性，并以最优传输同时求解神经元对应关系与全局参数，通过交替最小化一个共享的 Fisher 加权目标完成合并。理论分析证明该过程逐层单调降低合并目标，并给出刻画客户端异构与非均匀 Fisher 权重影响的平稳性界。多个数据集实验显示其在单轮与少轮设定下稳定优于对比基线，适用于通信受限场景下的联邦模型聚合。
arxiv.reason: 联邦学习模型聚合与最优传输对齐，与 LLM 后训练及 Agent 方向关联有限

arxiv.title: Continual Classification Beyond the Kernel Regime: Harnessing the Sparsity Bias of L2 Regularization in Diagonal Linear Networks
arxiv.abstract: We study logistic regression for continual learning with linear predictors in a high-dimensional statistical setting. Existing theoretical work has largely focused on continual linear regression with variants of L2 regularization, motivated by their analytical simplicity and connection to the kernel regime of neural networks. We first derive the optimal L2 regularization strength for continual linear classification and characterize its generalization performance, recovering behavior analogous to prior results for continual linear regression. Next, we examine the effect of L2 regularization in deeper models using a minimal two-layer diagonal linear network. In the single-task setting, L2 regularization on the weights of such models is known to promote sparsity in the resulting predictor, yielding a rich, sparse feature-learning regime beyond the kernel regime (a similar effect arises in two-layer ReLU networks). However, in continual learning, where L2 regularization is typically centered on previous-task weights, this sparsity bias is no longer preserved. We therefore propose a weighted variant of L2 regularization that extends this beneficial sparsity bias to continual learning. We show theoretically and empirically that, for a sufficiently sparse teacher, our variant converges substantially faster than directly learning a linear predictor with conventional continual L2 or L1 regularization, trading some long-horizon bias for markedly improved performance over moderate task horizons.
arxiv.titleZh: 超越核区制的持续分类：利用对角线性网络中 L2 正则化的稀疏偏好
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究高维统计设定下线性预测器的持续学习逻辑回归：先给出持续线性分类的最优 L2 正则强度并刻画其泛化性能，结果与此前持续线性回归的结论一致。随后用两层对角线性网络考察深层模型中 L2 正则的作用：单任务下权重 L2 正则会使预测器稀疏，带来超越核区制的稀疏特征学习；但在持续学习中，L2 通常以旧任务权重为中心，稀疏偏好不再保留。为此提出加权 L2 变体，将稀疏偏好延续到持续学习，理论分析与实验显示，当教师模型足够稀疏时，其收敛速度明显快于常规持续 L2 或 L1 正则，以一定长程偏差换取中等任务跨度上的显著性能提升。
arxiv.reason: 持续学习与核区制的纯理论研究，与 LLM 后训练及 Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: ConceptARC at Scale: Studying Conceptual Understanding in Reasoning Models
arxiv.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) perform well on challenging benchmarks, yet it remains unclear whether they form generalizable abstractions across conceptually related reasoning tasks. The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) provides a controlled testbed for studying abstraction, requiring solvers to infer transformation rules over two-dimensional grids from a small set of examples. While ARC evaluates rule abstraction within individual tasks, different tasks may share higher-level structure despite requiring different transformations$\unicode{x2014}$for example, several tasks may involve reasoning about objects contained within other objects. Benchmarks such as ConceptARC capture this structure by grouping ARC-style tasks into recurring spatial and semantic concepts, but they often contain only a few manually constructed tasks per concept. We introduce ConceptARC at Scale, a generator for creating thousands of ARC-style tasks targeting a specific concept. Using this generator, we construct ConceptARC-100, a dataset of 1,600 new, manually reviewed tasks, with 100 tasks for each of the 16 concepts defined by ConceptARC$\unicode{x2014}$ten times the size of the original benchmark. We evaluate a range of recent LRMs and models trained from scratch on ConceptARC-100 to characterize which concepts they solve reliably and where they struggle. We further analyze the models' internal representations and find clear semantic structure: task representations cluster according to the operations applied to objects, such as recoloring, removal, or translation, even when realized through substantially different rules and scenarios. Together, our results suggest that models form stable abstractions of transformation operations that generalize across diverse tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: ConceptARC at Scale：研究推理模型中的概念理解
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对大型推理模型能否在概念相关的推理任务间形成可泛化抽象这一问题，提出可针对特定概念批量生成数千个ARC风格任务的生成器，并构建ConceptARC-100：覆盖16个概念、每概念100个任务，共1600个经人工审核的新任务，规模为原基准的十倍。评测多种近期大型推理模型及从头训练模型，刻画各概念上的稳定解法与失败模式；内部表征分析显示，任务表征会按对物体施加的操作（如改色、删除、平移）聚类，即使规则与场景差异很大。该工作为抽象推理与推理模型评测提供了更大规模、可控的诊断集，并提示模型可形成跨任务稳定的变换操作抽象。
arxiv.reason: ARC抽象推理规模化评测，命中推理模型与评测方法学

arxiv.title: Template Gap Reconstruction for Shell Output Simulation with Small Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Small language models offer a compact basis for shell simulation without executing submitted commands, but full-output decoding requires them to predict recurring utility structure alongside content that varies across executions. We introduce template gap reconstruction (TGR), which supplies reusable output literals interspersed with sentinels to be interleaved with autoregressively generated gaps. A template selector chooses which template to be reconstructed, with the empty template retaining full-output decoding. We construct a template bank from 18.7 million outputs collected across heterogeneous execution environments and train a template selector and five reconstruction models initialized from various small language model checkpoints on a target environment excluded from bank construction. Evaluation demonstrates that TGR improves output edit similarity (O-ES) over full-output decoding (FOD) when the optimal template covers more than 25\% of the template, while performing similarly for lower-coverage outputs. Additionally, TGR outperforms FOD for shorter gap sequences, with O-ES values of 0.964 and 0.812, respectively, while maintaining similar performance for longer sequences. TGR reduces the number of tokens generated by 26.3--38.3\% across used tokenizer families. These results support using a reusable output structure as a practical design choice for small shell simulators, improving response fidelity and shortening generation targets while keeping template selection and residual prediction central to response quality.
arxiv.titleZh: 小语言模型 shell 输出模拟的模板缺口重建
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决小模型在不执行命令的前提下模拟 shell 输出时、需完整解码而难以兼顾固定工具结构与逐次变化内容的问题。方法是从 1870 万条跨异构执行环境的输出中构建模板库，模板由可复用输出字面量与哨兵占位符组成，由模板选择器决定重建哪个模板（空模板即退化为完整解码），再用五个基于不同小模型检查点初始化的重建模型自回归填充缺口。结果显示，当最优模板覆盖率超过 25% 时输出编辑相似度（O-ES）优于完整解码，短缺口序列下 O-ES 为 0.964 对 0.812，生成 token 数在所用分词器族上减少 26.3–38.3%。
arxiv.reason: 小模型 shell 输出模拟，与 Agent 环境合成擦边，方法偏增量

arxiv.title: Symmetry Breaking at the Edge of Stability via Central Flow Analysis
arxiv.abstract: Continuous symmetries in neural networks lead to conserved quantities that are invariant under gradient flow, such as layer balancedness in linear and ReLU networks. Finite-step gradient descent need not preserve these laws, particularly at the edge of stability (EOS), where the iterates oscillate around a smoother trajectory, which can be described by the central flow dynamics (Cohen et al., 2025). We study how gradient flow conservation laws evolve under the central flow description of this regime. We show that the curvature correction induces a finite-dimensional drift determined by the oscillation covariance along critical parameter directions. We thus take the first steps to analyse which conservation laws remain and are broken at the EOS according to the central flow dynamics by analysing a scalar two-layer model, two-layer matrix factorisation, and a two-layer ReLU network, where the known conservation laws are shown to be complete (Marcotte et al., 2023).
arxiv.titleZh: 通过中心流分析稳定性边缘处的对称性破缺
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经网络连续对称性在梯度流下给出层平衡等守恒量，但有限步梯度下降在稳定性边缘（EOS）会破坏这些规律，需用中心流描述振荡平均后的平滑轨迹。该工作分析中心流下守恒律如何演化，证明曲率修正会沿临界参数方向产生由振荡协方差决定的有限维漂移；在标量两层模型、两层矩阵分解和两层 ReLU 网络上刻画哪些守恒律保留、哪些被破坏，并借助已知守恒律完备的情形验证分析。
arxiv.reason: 纯优化动力学理论，未涉及 LLM，仅与训练稳定性弱相关

arxiv.title: Reasoning over Non-Parametric Memory in Multilingual LLMs: A Cognitive-Based Analysis of Relational Knowledge
arxiv.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) assumes that language models can reason over relations stated in their context rather than fall back on associations memorized during pretraining. We study this evidence-conditioned relational reasoning in isolation, with the facts supplied directly in the prompt rather than retrieved. \textsc{Rel-Bloom} is a controlled multilingual diagnostic of 450 multiple-choice questions built from 30 Wikidata relations; the same source relations are instantiated at five Bloom-inspired levels (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate) and under three veracity conditions (Factual, Counterfactual, Neutralized). Across 43 models, six languages, and two multilingual settings (226,800 predictions), three findings stand out. First, accuracy drops sharply from Apply to Analyze in every evaluated open-weight model series, reaching 47.2 percentage points for the Large Granite bucket, but not for either Gemini model. Second, Evaluate items remain a bottleneck even for models near ceiling on the other task types: Gemini~3.1 Pro averages 99.5\% on the other four levels but 60.7\% on Evaluate. Third, item- and relation-level difficulty rankings are consistently preserved across languages, indicating a difficulty structure partly shared across languages within this benchmark. Across knowledge conditions, Counterfactual contexts are generally harder than Factual ones, while removing entity identities can improve higher-level performance in some model regimes. Greater model capability therefore does not by itself ensure reliable reasoning over supplied relational evidence. Relevant resources are available at: https://huggingface.co/spaces/QCRI/non-parametric-memory-relational-reasoning.
arxiv.titleZh: 多语言LLM中非参数记忆上的推理：关系知识的认知分析
arxiv.summaryZh: RAG假设模型能对上下文中陈述的关系做推理，而非退回预训练时记住的关联。Rel-Bloom用30个Wikidata关系构造450道多选题，在五个Bloom层级（记忆、理解、应用、分析、评价）与三种真实性条件（事实、反事实、中和）下实例化同一批关系；覆盖43个模型、6种语言、共226,800次预测。结果显示：所有开源权重模型系列从Apply到Analyze精度骤降，Granite Large达47.2个百分点，而Gemini两代模型无此现象；Evaluate始终是瓶颈，Gemini 3.1 Pro其余四层平均99.5%、Evaluate仅60.7%；条目与关系难度排序跨语言保持一致，反事实语境普遍更难。结论是能力更强并不等于能可靠地对给定关系证据做推理。
arxiv.reason: RAG证据推理的多语言诊断基准，评测方向扎实

arxiv.title: Energy-Guided Transport for Projection-Free Physics-Informed Flow Matching
arxiv.abstract: Deep generative models, particularly Flow Matching frameworks, have emerged as powerful tools for synthesizing complex physical systems. However, standard architectures remain purely statistically driven and agnostic to the underlying governing equations, often violating fundamental physical constraints during inference. Existing zero-shot approaches designed to enforce these constraints typically rely on rigid algebraic projections. While effective for sparse boundary conditions, applying such discrete geometric corrections to dense, full-domain PDEs may disrupt the probability path, \rev{potentially deviating from the learned manifold and introducing substantial computational overhead}. To address these challenges, we introduce Energy-Guided Transport, a novel training-free framework that formulates non-linear physical constraints as a smooth potential energy landscape. Rather than interrupting the ODE integration, our method applies a continuous dissipative force directly to the intermediate generative states, steering them toward the physical manifold. By evaluating this force implicitly via reverse-mode automatic differentiation, our framework preserves the natural dynamics of the flow while maintaining an efficient $\mathcal{O}(N)$ algorithmic complexity. We extensively evaluate our framework across various 1D and 2D physical systems, including the chaotic Navier-Stokes equations. Our method achieves stable generation without structural divergence, significantly improves the stability-accuracy trade-off compared to state-of-the-art methods, and substantially accelerates inference with respect to exact projection strategies. Code available at: https://github.com/ispamm/Projection-free-energy-guided-flow-matching.
arxiv.titleZh: 能量引导传输：面向无投影物理信息流匹配的方法
arxiv.summaryZh: 解决流匹配生成物理系统时缺乏方程约束、推理阶段易违反物理守恒的问题。现有零样本方法依赖刚性代数投影，对稠密全域 PDE 会破坏概率路径并带来高额开销;该方法把非线性物理约束写成光滑势能景观，在 ODE 积分过程中对中间生成状态施加连续耗散力，隐式借助反向自动微分求力，复杂度保持 O(N)。在含混沌 Navier-Stokes 的多个 1D/2D 系统上实现无结构发散生成，稳定性与精度的权衡优于现有方法，推理速度明显快于精确投影。
arxiv.reason: 物理仿真生成的流匹配引导，与 LLM 及后训练方向无关

arxiv.title: ALTO: African and Levantine Tech-Facilitated Gender-Based Violence Corpus
arxiv.abstract: Tech-facilitated gender based violence (TFGBV) is a pervasive online harm affecting women and gender minority groups through its many direct and covert forms. Current models and annotated datasets for gendered harm detection are dominated by data from, and models trained in, Global North languages. In collaboration with civil society organizations (CSOs) from Jordan, Francophone West Africa, and Kenya, we developed a community-led approach to crowdsource culturally and linguistically relevant instances of TFGBV in Levantine Arabic, African French, and Swahili. We annotated the crowdsourced data using active learning to develop a small but performant dataset (N=3022) called ALTO to improve TFGBV detection in the three languages. Through benchmarking and fine-tuning experiments, we show that existing harmful content detection models show poor TFGBV recall within ALTO and improve with fine-tuning. We found that models often miss covert harms across all languages, while error rates are markedly higher in Swahili. We report the experimental results and release the annotation taxonomy, dataset, and trained models.

arxiv.titleZh: ALTO:非洲与黎凡特地区技术促成的性别暴力语料库
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有性别暴力内容检测模型与标注数据由全球北方语言主导，覆盖语言有限。工作与约旦、法语西非和肯尼亚的民间组织合作，以社区主导方式众包黎凡特阿拉伯语、非洲法语与斯瓦希里语的技术促成性别暴力(TFGBV)实例，并用主动学习标注，构建规模不大但性能较好的 ALTO 数据集(N=3022)。基准测试与微调实验显示，现有有害内容检测模型在 ALTO 上 TFGBV 召回率偏低，微调后可获提升;模型在各语言上普遍漏检隐性伤害，斯瓦希里语错误率明显更高。作者公开标注分类体系、数据集与训练模型，可用于低资源语言的有害内容检测与安全对齐评测。

arxiv.title: Where It Breaks: Diagnosing Perception, Memory, and Decision Failures of a Vision-Language Agent in Pac-Man
arxiv.abstract: Training an agent to play Pac-Man with only up, down, left and right actions raises a basic question: when performance is poor, what should be improved? Difficulty can arise from reading the screen or from choosing actions over a long sequence. We examine these problems in a Qwen3.5-9B-based agent through separate perception checks and primitive-policy reinforcement-learning studies. In the policy study, which uses textual boards to remove image transcription from the decision interface, completion on eight held-out mazes increased from 0% before this optimization to 80.2% at a selected checkpoint, with three extra lives. The perception checks show that accurate static screenshot reading can coexist with errors during interaction. A separate policy comparison also shows that further optimization can accompany worse action choices. Together, these findings motivate concrete checks for post-training: evaluate perception in use, distinguish training success from full-game validation, and examine decisions and later performance rather than relying on one selected score. The study provides empirical lessons for improving future agent training and evaluation.
arxiv.titleZh: 断在哪里:诊断视觉语言智能体在吃豆人中的感知、记忆与决策失败
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对仅用上下左右四个动作玩吃豆人的视觉语言智能体，拆解性能瓶颈究竟来自读屏还是长序列动作选择。以Qwen3.5-9B为基础，用独立感知测试与底层策略强化学习实验分离两类问题;在文本棋盘接口下，八个留出迷宫的通关率从优化前的0%升至选定checkpoint的80.2%(三条额外生命)。感知测试显示，静态截图识别准确可与交互过程中的错误并存;策略对比也表明，进一步优化可能伴随更差的动作选择。据此提出后训练检查建议:在使用中评感知、区分训练成功与整局验证、关注决策与后续表现而非单一分数。

arxiv.title: PINR-ESI: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Implicit Neural Representation Framework for EEG Extended-Source Imaging
arxiv.abstract: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents showed the clearest advantage in identifying active cortical regions, particularly for multiple and larger sources. Quantitative and qualitative evaluations using real EEG recordings from epilepsy patients and intracranial stimulation experiments further supported the feasibility of the framework for source imaging. These findings suggest the potential of physics-informed self-supervised INR for extended-source imaging.
arxiv.titleZh: PINR-ESI：用于EEG扩展源成像的物理信息自监督隐式神经表示框架
arxiv.summaryZh: EEG扩展源成像需要定位活跃皮层区域并刻画其空间范围，而现有监督式逆问题网络依赖人工合成的EEG-源配对数据，容易受合成数据与真实数据分布不匹配的影响。该工作把皮层电流密度建模为连续坐标条件下的隐式神经表示场，用导联场矩阵编码源到传感器的容积传导模型，通过预测EEG与实测EEG的一致性约束网络，无需配对源标签或仿真预训练；同时以经典逆问题解做暖启动与空间约束，并用分块积分投影把连续场映射为离散源系数以完成前向建模。在不同噪声水平、源数量与源范围的仿真中，该方法在识别活跃皮层区域上优势最明显，尤其是多源与大范围源；癫痫患者真实EEG与颅内刺激实验的定量与定性评估也支持其可行性。
arxiv.reason: EEG源成像属生物医学影像应用，与LLM关注方向无交集

arxiv.title: Don't Replace, Complement: A Detector-Agnostic Subspace Signal for Near-OOD Detection
arxiv.abstract: Post-hoc out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is mature on far-OOD yet remains weak on near-OOD. These two settings differ in their use of class-characteristic feature directions: far-OOD inputs largely fail to activate those of their predicted class, whereas near-OOD inputs activate them much as in-distribution samples do. Because the axis separating far-OOD leaves near-OOD almost indistinguishable from ID, a score optimized for one setting is misaligned with the other; where a detector already saturates far-OOD, added near-OOD sensitivity is bought partly against it. This divergence motivates a targeted near-OOD signal designed to complement existing scores. We propose PLUS (Per-class Low-dimensional sUbspace Signal). For each class, PLUS selects the $m$ most class-active neurons from a sparse autoencoder, orthonormalizes the corresponding decoder directions to form a low-dimensional subspace, and scores an input by its per-class whitened squared Mahalanobis distance $z$ within the subspace of its predicted class. Designed as a dedicated complement rather than a standalone detector, the signal $z$ is fused additively with any calibrated base score at a single, fixed weight. This weight is a single global constant: no value is adjusted per backbone, per OOD dataset, or per deployment, and all calibration statistics are estimated from ID validation data alone. When applied to 18 existing detectors spanning diverse method families, $z$ consistently improves near-OOD AUROC in all 126 detector--backbone combinations. Far-OOD performance is broadly maintained or improved, with only marginal declines where the base score is near-optimal, making $z$ a robust, detector-agnostic complement across backbones.
arxiv.titleZh: 不要替换，而要补充:一种与检测器无关的近-OOD 检测子空间信号
arxiv.summaryZh: 后验 OOD 检测在远-OOD 上已较成熟，但近-OOD 仍薄弱:远-OOD 输入几乎不激活预测类别的类特征方向，近-OOD 则激活得与分布内样本相似，导致面向远-OOD 优化的分数与近-OOD 需求错位。为此提出 PLUS:对每个类别从稀疏自编码器中选出最活跃的 m 个神经元，将其解码方向正交归一化构成低维子空间，并用预测类子空间内白化平方 Mahalanobis 距离 z 打分;z 以单一固定全局权重与任意已校准基分数加性融合，无需按骨干或数据集调参。在 18 种检测器、126 个检测器-骨干组合上，z 全部提升近-OOD AUROC，远-OOD 基本保持或改善，仅在基分数近最优处轻微下降。该工作把近-OOD 信号定位为可插拔补充项，适合需要复用现有检测管线的部署场景。
arxiv.reason: OOD 检测属可靠性方法，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线关联有限

arxiv.title: LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
arxiv.abstract: We introduce LifeVal, a benchmark evaluating AI model performance on personalized agentic consumer tasks. LifeVal covers the most valuable life tasks that a personalized digital superassistant could automate, representing over 1.7 trillion US dollars in annual willingness-to-pay across 148 consumer task categories (e.g., managing finances, moving apartments, searching for a job, finding childcare). To construct our activity distribution, we conducted a new survey of willingness-to-pay for a digital superassistant across a demographically representative sample of over 3,800 consumers, cross-referencing our results against the American Time Use Survey (Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025) and the Multinational Time Use Study (Fisher et al., 2025). For the most valuable consumer activities, we recruited task creators to create AI evaluation tasks personalized using real ChatGPT conversations and memories, reference files, and personal context. Task creators had to pass our expertise threshold (including personally completing the task multiple times and seeing the results through in their real lives for over a year) and also write a rubric, ensuring that our evaluation measured the best personalized completion for that task. All tasks had to pass at least three rounds of human quality-control before acceptance into our final evaluation sets.
arxiv.titleZh: LifeVal:评估 AI 模型在个性化 Agent 消费任务上的表现
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有评测难以衡量数字助理在真实个人事务上的个性化完成能力。LifeVal 构建了覆盖 148 类消费任务的基准，先通过对 3800 余名具人口代表性消费者的支付意愿调查，并结合美国时间使用调查与跨国时间使用研究，确定年支付意愿合计逾 1.7 万亿美元的高价值生活任务(理财、搬家、求职、托育等)。随后由通过专业门槛的任务创建者，基于真实 ChatGPT 对话与记忆、参考文件和个人背景编写个性化任务与评分 rubric，所有任务需通过至少三轮人工质检。该基准面向个性化 Agent 的高价值真实场景评测，可作为衡量超级助理落地能力的参照。
arxiv.reason: 个性化 Agent 真实任务基准，属 Agent 与评测方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: SecureGARD: Dynamic Ontology-Guided Governance for Secure Tool-Using LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents translate model outputs into consequential actions, turning indirect prompt injection into an execution-security problem. Existing defenses constrain tool calls, trajectories, or information flows, but often leave action semantics, state dependencies, and evidence relations implicit, limiting generalization across heterogeneous tools and complicating safe updates. We present \ours{}, a dynamic ontology-guided governance framework. \ours{} grounds heterogeneous calls in a shared semantic representation and combines an executable ontology with episode-level task state to derive deterministic ready, waiting, and forbidden decisions. A waiting decision identifies an unmet but recoverable obligation, enabling bounded replanning without expanding the agent's authorization boundary. \ours{} evolves its ontology offline from verified training executions. An offline LLM proposes instance-independent action--state axioms, which are accepted only if they address ontology errors exposed by training failures, preserve logical consistency and protected entailments, and pass held-out validation before the ontology is frozen. We evaluate \ours{} on AgentDojo, ASB, and AgentDyn under benign and indirect prompt-injection settings. \ours{} achieves a 0\% attack success rate (ASR) across all three benchmarks while improving task utility under attack compared with existing baselines. These results show that explicit semantic governance can strengthen execution security without indiscriminate blocking.
arxiv.titleZh: SecureGARD：面向安全工具调用型 LLM Agent 的动态本体引导治理
arxiv.summaryZh: 工具调用型 LLM Agent 会把模型输出变成实际动作，间接提示注入因此从内容安全问题变成执行安全问题；现有防御只在工具调用、轨迹或信息流层面做约束，动作语义、状态依赖与证据关系仍隐含，跨工具泛化与安全更新都受限。SecureGARD 用共享语义表示统一异构调用，把可执行本体与回合级任务状态结合，给出 ready / waiting / forbidden 的确定性判定；waiting 表示存在未满足但可恢复的义务，可在不扩大授权边界的前提下做有界重规划，本体则由已验证训练执行离线演化并冻结。在 AgentDojo、ASB、AgentDyn 的良性设置与间接提示注入设置下，ASR 为 0%，受攻击时的任务效用也优于现有基线。
arxiv.reason: Agent 执行安全与本体治理，属 Agent 方向扎实系统工作

arxiv.title: Do unlearning algorithms learn the right features?
arxiv.abstract: Machine unlearning is commonly evaluated with standard post-deletion metrics that compare an unlearned model to one retrained on the remaining data. Such snapshot evaluations can conceal consequential differences in the features the two models encode. We prove that if an unlearned and a retrained model agree on their outputs but encode different features, a single gradient step on their prediction heads can break this agreement. We further show that deleting an arbitrarily small fraction of the data can cause retraining to select qualitatively different features, so matching retraining can require learning features that the full model never had. We then introduce a measure of feature recovery that separates missing from extraneous features. Across eight unlearning methods, models that perform well on standard metrics often fail to recover the retrained features. This mismatch predicts deviations from retraining under subsequent relearning and downstream adaptation, and directly correcting it systematically reduces these deviations.
arxiv.titleZh: 遗忘算法学到的是正确的特征吗？
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准遗忘评测只看遗忘模型与剩余数据重训模型的输出是否一致，这种快照式比较会掩盖二者编码特征的差异。论文证明，若两模型输出一致但特征不同，只需对预测头做一步梯度更新即可打破一致；并证明删除极小比例数据就能让重训选出性质不同的特征，因此对齐重训可能要求学到完整模型从未拥有的特征。为此提出一种区分「缺失特征」与「多余特征」的特征恢复度量，在八种遗忘方法上发现标准指标表现优异者常无法恢复重训特征，且该失配可预测后续再学习与下游适配中的偏差，直接校正该失配能系统性减小偏差。
arxiv.reason: 遗忘算法的评测方法学分析扎实，但与 LLM 后训练主线仅部分相关

arxiv.title: Self-Directed Apple Tasting
arxiv.abstract: We study the classical apple-tasting setting, a partial feedback model in which the learner observes the true label only when it predicts $1$. A combinatorial characterization for the rates of this problem in the online adversarial setting has been studied by Raman et al. (2024). We study the self-directed setting, in which the learner can adaptively choose the order of the points it predicts on. In the realizable setting, we establish a tetrachotomy on the expected minimax number of mistakes made by any learner. Depending on the VC dimension, the $\emptyset$-centered star number, and the self-directed dimension, we show that the rates could possibly be $Θ(1)$, $O(\log n) \cap ω(1)$, $\tilde Θ(\sqrt{n})$, or $Θ(n)$. In the agnostic setting, the minimax regret is $\tilde Θ(\sqrt{n})$ or $Θ(n)$, depending on the VC dimension.
arxiv.titleZh: 自导式苹果品尝
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究苹果品尝这一部分反馈模型：仅当预测为 1 时学习者才能观察到真实标签。在自导式设定中，学习者可自适应选择预测点的顺序；可实现设定下，依据 VC 维、空中心星数与自导维数，期望 minimax 错误数呈现四分类：Θ(1)、O(log n)∩ω(1)、Θ̃(√n) 或 Θ(n)。不可知设定下，minimax 遗憾为 Θ̃(√n) 或 Θ(n)，取决于 VC 维。
arxiv.reason: 纯在线学习理论，与 LLM 方向无关

arxiv.title: AgentTrustCI: Build-Time Policy, Grounding, and Trajectory Tests for Java LLM Agents
arxiv.abstract: Infrastructure security does not establish whether an LLM agent selected an allowed tool, grounded its answer in tool output, or followed a required workflow. AgentTrustCI is a Java/JUnit 5 framework that expresses these application-layer expectations as policy, grounding, and trajectory checks over recorded traces. A deterministic replay implementation supports repeatable build-time tests; a judge interface provides an extension point for optional semantic evaluation. On 55 synthetic cases spanning seven enterprise domains, the full pipeline correctly classifies all 30 injected faults and 25 passing controls, including ten non-trivial controls, and misses none of 12 designated critical cases. Each single-layer configuration correctly classifies 35 cases because the corpus deliberately isolates ten faults per layer. A grounded answer obtained through a disallowed sequence illustrates the additional coverage of trajectory checks. Repeated measurements quantify validator execution separately from process startup and reporting. These results establish coverage of the authored regression suite, not production accuracy. We describe a production-trace validation protocol, optional LLM-judge integration, and maintenance of expectations as workflows evolve. The contribution is a practical pattern for expressing behavioral contracts within an existing Java release pipeline.
arxiv.comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 International Conference on Computer and Applications (ICCA)
arxiv.titleZh: AgentTrustCI：面向 Java LLM Agent 的构建期策略、接地与轨迹测试
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对基础设施安全无法判定 LLM Agent 是否选用被允许的工具、回答是否由工具输出支撑、是否遵循既定工作流的问题，AgentTrustCI 用 Java/JUnit 5 把这类应用层期望写成基于记录轨迹的策略、接地与轨迹三类检查，确定性回放保证构建期可重复，judge 接口为可选语义评估留扩展点。在覆盖七个企业领域的 55 个合成用例上，完整流水线正确分类全部 30 个注入故障与 25 个通过对照(含 10 个非平凡对照),12 个关键用例无一漏检;单层配置各正确分类 35 例，因语料刻意让每层隔离 10 个故障。一个经不合规序列得到的合规接地答案说明轨迹检查的额外覆盖，结果仅代表所编写回归套件的覆盖而非生产准确率。
arxiv.reason: Agent 轨迹与策略测试框架，方向擦边且评测仅限自造用例

arxiv.title: Where Search Agents Go Off the Rails: Graph-Grounded Step-Level Verification
arxiv.abstract: Search-augmented reasoning systems can reach correct answers while making errors in intermediate steps. Reliable auditing must check whether evidence $D$ covers the question $Q$, reasoning $T$ addresses $Q$, and $T$ is grounded in $D$. We introduce GraphRail, which represents requirements, evidence, and reasoning as structured claims and compares them without a generative judge or gold answer. Across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three reasoning frameworks, GraphRail improves error recall over generative verifiers while remaining stable under stochastic extraction. Its diagnoses can also guide online reasoning, providing a traceable way to detect and correct intermediate errors.
arxiv.titleZh: 搜索Agent在哪一步跑偏：基于图结构的步骤级验证
arxiv.summaryZh: 检索增强推理系统常出现「答案对、过程错」，现有审计依赖生成式评判器或标准答案。GraphRail 把问题需求、证据与推理链统一表示为结构化 claim，在图上比对二者的覆盖与支撑关系，从而分别判定证据是否覆盖问题、推理是否回应问题、推理是否由证据支撑，全程不需要生成式 judge 或 gold answer。在三个多跳 QA benchmark、三种推理框架上，其错误召回率优于生成式验证器，且在抽取结果存在随机波动时仍保持稳定；诊断信号还可在线引导推理，定位并纠正中间步骤错误。
arxiv.reason: 搜索Agent步骤级验证，免judge免标准答案，命中Agent与评测方向

arxiv.title: Fingerprinting the Dispatchers behind Distributed Model Extraction
arxiv.abstract: API distillation campaigns try to hide model-stealing traffic by splitting requests across thousands of load-balanced accounts, which standard content classifiers often miss. However, request timestamps, specifically arrival time and stream completion time, reveal the underlying dispatching strategy, such as round-robin counters or key-shuffling pools. Using a 20 percent seed set, this timing analysis can forensically rank the remaining accounts of a campaign with 0.92 to 1.00 AUC within 20 minutes, even across thousands of real production accounts. While adaptive attackers struggle to hide rotating dispatchers using jitter, pinning keys successfully evades detection, though it can severely throttle throughput when quotas bind. Ultimately, timing exposes shared infrastructure patterns even when content filters fail.
arxiv.titleZh: 指纹识别分布式模型提取背后的调度器
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 API 蒸馏活动把窃取模型的请求分散到数千个负载均衡账号、绕过内容分类器的问题，利用请求到达时间与流完成时间指纹识别底层调度策略（轮询计数器、键重排池等）。仅用 20% 种子账号，即可在 20 分钟内对剩余账号做取证排序，在数千个真实生产账号上取得 0.92 至 1.00 AUC。攻击者加入抖动难以隐藏轮换式调度器，改用键固定虽可规避检测，但在配额受限时会严重压低吞吐。结果表明，即使内容过滤失效，时序仍能暴露共享基础设施模式。
arxiv.reason: LLM API 窃取检测，属安全交叉，与后训练/Agent 主线偏离

arxiv.title: Replicability, Reproducibility, and Robustness in Political and Social Science Research with Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: This chapter addresses the central reproducibility problem of research with large language models. LLM output is probabilistic and varies across models and versions, which can have significant effects on downstream statistical results. The chapter distinguishes between replicability, reproducibility, and robustness, and proposes a probabilistic standard based on the distribution of results, not identical outputs. It introduces a standardized prompt script, tests within-model variation for encoders and decoders, and develops error-structure analysis to diagnose where models err and whether their errors align. Using three datasets, the chapter shows that measurement choice can reverse the sign of downstream regression coefficients. Existing design-based corrections with gold-labeled subsamples restore validity, but come at the cost of estimate precision. The main contribution of the chapter is a stacked ensemble of open-weight models that improves precision in the correction step while retaining estimate validity.
arxiv.comment: Chapter 5 of "LLMs in Political and Social Science: Principles and Applications of Transformer Models," Oxford University Press, forthcoming 2027. Data and code: https://github.com/llms-political-social-science-book-oup/book-code-data
arxiv.titleZh: 政治与社会科学研究中大语言模型的可复制性、可复现性与稳健性
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM输出的概率性与跨模型、跨版本波动会显著改变下游统计结论这一复现难题，区分replicability、reproducibility与robustness三个层次，提出以结果分布而非输出完全一致为标准的概率化复现规范。给出标准化prompt脚本，分别测量encoder与decoder类模型的模型内变异，并构建误差结构分析，用于判断模型在何处出错、误差是否同向。基于三个数据集显示，测量方案的选择足以让下游回归系数符号反转；带金标注子样本的设计型校正确能恢复有效性，但以牺牲估计精度为代价。主要贡献是开权重模型的堆叠集成，在校正环节同时保住估计有效性与精度。
arxiv.reason: LLM可复现性方法学，切中评测可靠性但偏社科应用

arxiv.title: From Certified Pairs to a Certified Hub: Reasoner-Checked Crosswalks for the Information Exchange Standard
arxiv.abstract: A national digital twin was conceived as an ecosystem of twins connected through mappings to a common foundation, but the roadmap that promises to confirm those mappings are valid never says what valid means. We give the test a precise form, coherence and conservativity of the merged ontology, borrowed from logic-based alignment repair, and apply it to the Information Exchange Standard (IES), first pair by pair and then to whole hubs. Crosswalks from IES into thirteen ontologies across seven sector groups, anchored on the building ontologies BOT, Brick, and SAREF4BLDG, pass through separate stages of matching, human review, certification of each SKOS correspondence against the two class hierarchies, and reasoning with HermiT. Pair by pair, the stages catch different failures: certification alone removed all 526 conservativity violations of the raw crosswalks, review alone left 73, and together they made eleven of twelve overlapping pairs coherent and conservative. Pairwise certification does not compose. Merging the three certified building crosswalks into one hub made five Brick classes unsatisfiable, through a homonym between the IES and Brick notions of a floor that only BOT's disjointness axioms expose; rejecting that one row gave a coherent and conservative hub that entails 290 cross-ontology links nobody wrote down. The core hub is inconsistent before any crosswalk is added, because two published standards, the Open Energy Ontology and BFO 2020, contradict each other; with either one left out it is coherent and conservative. A hub, not a pair, is the unit an ecosystem of twins has to certify.
arxiv.titleZh: 从已认证配对到认证枢纽：面向信息交换标准的推理器校验跨本体映射
arxiv.summaryZh: 数字孪生生态依赖本体映射，但“映射有效”缺少可检验定义。该工作把有效性形式化为合并本体的coherence与conservativity，并用于Information Exchange Standard（IES）到13个本体的跨本体映射：依次做匹配、人工审核、逐条SKOS对应认证和HermiT推理。逐对认证消除了原始映射全部526个保守性违规，与审核结合使12对中11对一致且保守；但配对认证不可组合，三个建筑映射合并后因IES与Brick的floor同名异义、经BOT不相交公理暴露，使5个Brick类不可满足，删去该行后hub蕴含290条未显式写出的跨本体链接。核心hub在加入映射前已因Open Energy Ontology与BFO 2020矛盾而不一致，表明认证单元应是hub而非配对。
arxiv.reason: 本体映射认证，与LLM/Agent关注方向无关

arxiv.title: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
arxiv.abstract: We present a shared framework that adapts Cosmos world foundation models for real-time interactive world simulation in Physical AI. By streaming visual observations in response to actions and scene controls, the framework enables users and embodied agents to interact with evolving virtual environments. It supports both predicting the visual consequences of actions and generating observations from physical state maintained by an external simulator. We demonstrate this approach across camera navigation and robot manipulation, controllable video transfer, and multi-view autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation. These examples provide a shared foundation for developing interactive virtual environments for Physical AI training and evaluation. Our code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3-examples. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos-simulation.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向 Physical AI 的 Cosmos 交互式世界仿真
arxiv.summaryZh: 把 Cosmos 世界基础模型改造成可按动作与场景控制实时流式输出视觉观测的交互式仿真框架，让用户与具身智能体在持续演化的虚拟环境中交互。框架同时支持两种模式：直接预测动作带来的视觉后果，以及根据外部仿真器维护的物理状态生成观测画面。在相机导航、机器人操作、可控视频迁移与多视角自动驾驶仿真上做了演示，并开源代码与模型权重。其定位是为 Physical AI 的训练与评测提供可复用的交互式虚拟环境基础。
arxiv.reason: 世界模型视频生成与机器人、自动驾驶仿真，落在低分方向

arxiv.title: Dimension-Free Private Mean Estimation is Impossible Without the Covariance
arxiv.abstract: We study the limits of differentially private Gaussian mean estimation when the covariance matrix is unknown. Prior work shows that when the covariance $Σ$ is known, the optimal sample complexity can depend only on its spectrum, rather than on the ambient dimension $d$. We establish new lower bounds for Gaussian mean estimation with Euclidean error which show that private estimators cannot achieve similar guarantees when the covariance is unknown. First, when the sample size $n$ is smaller than the effective dimension $\mathrm{trace}(Σ)/\|Σ\|_{\text{op}}$, the optimal error when the covariance is unknown can be larger than the optimal error when it is known by a factor of $\sqrt{d/n}$. Second, when the sample size is larger than the effective dimension, even for diagonal covariance matrices with effective dimension bounded by $\log d$, the optimal error when the covariance is unknown can be larger than the optimal error when it is known by a factor of $\sqrt{d}/n^{3/2}$. Together, these results show that in the unknown covariance setting, exploiting anisotropic structure under differential privacy can require a dimension-dependent error or sample complexity.
arxiv.titleZh: 协方差未知时，无维度依赖的差分隐私均值估计不可能
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究协方差矩阵未知时差分隐私高斯均值估计的极限。已有工作表明协方差已知时最优样本复杂度可只依赖其谱而非环境维度 d；该文给出欧氏误差下的新下界：当样本量 n 小于有效维度 trace(Σ)/‖Σ‖op 时，未知协方差的最优误差可比已知时大 √(d/n) 倍；当 n 大于有效维度时，即使协方差为对角阵且有效维度不超过 log d，未知协方差的最优误差也可大 √d/n^{3/2} 倍。结果表明在差分隐私下利用各向异性结构需要维度相关的误差或样本复杂度。
arxiv.reason: 差分隐私估计理论，与 LLM 关注方向无关

arxiv.title: From Reconstruction to Imputation: Test-Time Optimization for Missing Time-Series Channels
arxiv.abstract: Complete sensor-channel failures create a difficult form of time-series missingness: local interpolation is unavailable, and deploying a separately trained imputer for every failure pattern may be impractical. We ask whether a sequence reconstructor trained without artificial mask augmentation and then frozen can be converted into an imputer at inference time. Our method treats the missing entries of each test window as optimization variables, clamps all observations, and backpropagates through the frozen model to minimize reconstruction error only on observed coordinates. The resulting observed-self-consistency objective requires neither artificial mask augmentation nor full-channel dropout during reconstructor training. We characterize when this refinement is informative through the cross-Jacobian from missing inputs to observed residuals, and use an optional temporal-smoothness prior when that coupling is weak. Across five real-world datasets with exactly one channel synthetically masked per test window and four reconstruction architectures, no-prior test-time refinement reduces MAE relative to one-pass reconstruction in 19 of 20 dataset-backbone combinations. Compared with mask-aware imputers trained under either standard structured masks or matched full-channel dropout, the best refined reconstructor achieves the lowest MAE on two datasets and trails the strongest baseline on three. These gains require substantially more inference time and are sensitive to cross-channel coupling. Our results establish test-time self-consistency as a conditional inference-time adapter for frozen reconstruction models that complements mask-aware imputation without retraining the reconstructor.
arxiv.titleZh: 从重建到填补：面向缺失时间序列通道的测试时优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 完整通道失效使局部插值不可用，为每种失效模式单独训练填补器也不现实，能否把冻结的序列重建器在推理时直接当作填补器？方法将测试窗口的缺失项视为优化变量、固定全部观测值，经冻结模型反传，仅在观测坐标上最小化重建误差，并以缺失到观测残差的交叉雅可比刻画精修何时有效，耦合弱时加时间平滑先验。五个真实数据集与四种重建架构的20个组合中（每窗口屏蔽一个通道），19个组合MAE低于单次重建；最佳精修模型在两个数据集上优于掩码感知填补器，三个数据集上落后最强基线。测试时自一致性由此成为冻结重建模型的条件式推理期适配器，代价是推理开销上升且对跨通道耦合敏感。
arxiv.reason: 时序缺失填补，与LLM主线无交集，仅测试时优化略沾边

arxiv.title: Alternatives to Shallow Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering
arxiv.abstract: Collaborative filtering (CF) is a cornerstone of recommender systems and plays a relevant role in many modern applications. CF uses user-item interaction data to discover future preferences. Although deep learning models have shown promise in CF, Embarrassingly Shallow Autoencoders for Sparse Data (EASE) has gained attention for its outstanding ranking accuracy provided by its closed-form solution. EASE relies primarily on relationships among items to fit a full-rank high-dimensional linear mapping. We hypothesize that this design limits its capacity to capture similar but not equivalent fine-grained user relationships, consequently limiting its recommendation accuracy. This paper introduces an alternative formulation based on EASE that takes advantage of user-user information. Furthermore, we propose a hybrid model that combines both user-user and item-item adjacency distributions. Our experiments reveal that the proposed models outperform EASE on well-known recommendation benchmarks, highlighting the significance of including the user alternative in shallow autoencoder studies for CF.
arxiv.titleZh: 协同过滤中浅层自编码器的替代方案
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 EASE 仅依赖物品-物品关系、难以刻画细粒度用户相似性的局限，提出以用户-用户信息为基础的替代形式，并构建融合用户-用户与物品-物品邻接分布的混合模型。在多个常用推荐基准上，所提模型的排序精度优于 EASE，表明浅层自编码器研究中引入用户侧信息的价值。
arxiv.reason: 推荐系统协同过滤线性模型，与 LLM 方向基本无关
